style_when: the story turns on one physical thing — a part, a material, a component, a document — and what that thing costs, contains or crosses a border is the news
prompt: Extreme close-up macro photograph, 100mm macro lens, razor-sharp focal plane. A heavy, high-end workstation processor chip resting on a matte dark grey testing bench, with a precision brass mechanical stopwatch resting partially over its metallic heat spreader. Shallow depth of field, visible surface texture on the brushed metal and subtle dust motes in the air. Soft directional daylight falling from the left, highlighting the precision contact pins and the glass of the stopwatch dial. The hero objects are positioned off-centre on the right third, with the background falling away into a smooth, dark out-of-focus blur. Modern editorial cover standard.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, watermarks, UI, typography, logos
rationale: The story turns precisely on a physical hardware artifact—a workstation CPU—and a specific measurement of time. An extreme macro shot emphasizes the tangible component at the center of this economic calculation.
